review: The original operator and skill widgets move to permanent selectors; the same QFormLayout and relic controls stay in a mature superqt fold with bounded native scrolling. The existing mechanism QTextBrowser provides styled headings and named anchors. The result selector indexes actual generated report heading blocks only; it does not parse/recompute numeric values. Original text replacement retains reading and selection; signal-blocked navigation rebuilds only when text changes and resets on changed input identity. Capability headings come from the existing report, so fee/healing/damage sections stay specific. Technical switches remain with existing tools. Reporting changes only three exact presentation phrases, keeping None unknown and partial-relic scope. Explicit archive mode removes run_config only for the selected current-calculator preview, records its mode and labels the report; default run behavior and private records remain. No automatic fallback, retry or new catch.
